purpose: Before issuing archive/data requests, recheck the user's existing File Library for the exact sources required by the closure router. This avoids requesting material already held locally and records negative local-search results without treating them as institutional non-existence claims.

guard: A negative File Library search means only that the exact source was not recovered from the user's currently searchable uploaded files. It is not evidence that the source does not exist in the institution or elsewhere.
operational_result: Four external/exact-source requests remain. No further local broad searching is warranted until new files are added.
